description:
Reads group pending requests using a matching player session.
Use when: opening a group screen or reconciling an uncertain action.
Not for: unbounded group search, automatic pagination or using stale snapshots after a session change.
Requires: userId and the player's session: sign in with horizon_signin_email or horizon_signin_anonymous and pass its accessToken as sessionToken. Leader/officer membership.
Side effects: None (read only).
Returns: {groupId,revision,invitations,joinRequests,serverTime}; complete retained entries, including after policy reductions.
Errors: Use horizon_get_groups and horizon_get_group_pending to reconcile state. 409 REVISION_CONFLICT or uncertain response: read and reconcile intent, never refresh the revision and repeat automatically. Pending decisions require the original requestId; REQUEST_NOT_FOUND means it was removed/replaced. INBOX_FULL rolls back the entire action. 403 rejects group role, session or bilateral block violations. 429 is reported without automatic retry. 401 means the session is missing or expired: sign in again and retry with the new accessToken. 403 for a session means the token belongs to another user: pass the userId that signed in. Needs HORIZON_API_KEY. Every failure returns an error result (isError) with the HTTP status and body: a 401 that horizon_test_connection also returns means HORIZON_API_KEY is wrong, 429 means the account's per-minute rate limit was reached (wait a minute, then retry).

groupId.description: Exact group UUID in the current project; never an authorization credential

sessionToken.description: Player accessToken, sent only in Authorization

userId.description: Signed-in player matching the Bearer session

name: horizon_get_group_pending
title: Get Group Pending Requests
